purpose: Unit fixture: coupled inductors (1:1 transformer), sine drive.

oracle.derivation: Coupled inductors, M = K sqrt(L1 L2) = 0.99 mH: [L1 M; M L2] d[i(l1), i(l2)]/dt = [v(in) - 50 i(l1), -1k i(l2)] from rest, v(in) = sin(2 pi 10k t), integrated by scipy DOP853 at rtol 1e-12; v(p) = v(in) - 50 i(l1), v(s) = -1k i(l2), i(vin) = -i(l1). The previous oracle, ngspice-44.2 at default options, was 145x its tolerance off (36% low in i(l1) at the first samples); ngspice-44.2 at reltol 1e-7 and tmax 1e-7 is still 182x off, while Xyce 7.10.0 at reltol 1e-6 agrees within 0.07x.
